selection: Reuse every previously fixed supported complete cohort PA (151 PAs/563 pitches); retain all cohort PA/pitch denominators and exclusion reasons from the six full games; no reselection
inputs: April selected TRAIN-only repertoire and median zone bounds via prior_zone_inputs; frozen batter profiles as_of 2025-04-30; observed pre-pitch count and state only
stability: Existing independently trained checkpoint members separately, fixed delivery draws/frequency/blend weight and each checkpoint calibration; not full-pipeline retraining uncertainty or confidence intervals
ranks: All supported pitch_type x zone actions; descending unrounded Q; ties resolved by original adapter action index; actual type rank is its best supported zone action; also report unique-type rank
value_gap: 100 * (max_action_Q - max_Q_for_actual_type), percentage points; best available target for observed type, not actual intended-target or realized-location value
support: Full cohort eligibility separately from evaluation-conditional ready/type/action/actual-type support; retain per-type-zone counts, kernel ESS and mass; no invented rank/value for unsupported actual type
uncertainty: Descriptive counts/ranges first; any aggregate CI uses paired game-cluster bootstrap and is exploratory with only six games; member spread is not a confidence interval
prediction_metrics: Reuse prior EXP-A-COMMON-001 separately; no new predicted-outcome advantage claim
evaluation_use: Already-exposed exploratory July 2025 DEV; no 2026, final evaluation or CV data
decision: Diagnosis only; actual-type match not adoption metric. A reviews this run before preregistering at most two candidates; no model or threshold tuning in this run
